title: Caldera Pharma - Field Integration Scratchpad
content:
Quick context: Caldera Pharma is evaluating Redwood Private for a regulatory-sensitive inference pipeline (patient triage summarization + PII redaction). Pilot scope: ingest clinical intake forms, run extraction and normalization, produce a structured JSON summary and redaction mask. They want to run in their GCP VPC with HSM-backed keys and strict audit logging.

Meeting notes (2024-11-07 call w/ Caldera eng + product):
- Attendees: Maya (RWI CS), Jamal (RWI Solutions Eng), Priya (Caldera eng lead), Liam (Caldera infra), Dr. S. Patel (product owner).
- Business priority: replace slow rule-based pipeline (human-in-the-loop) with automated summarization to cut TAT from 8h -> target 30–90s for initial triage. Not full automation for production yet; human review for critical flags.
- Data residency: all PHI must remain in their GCP project; cannot send to hosted API.
- Compliance: logs must be retained 2 years; audit trail per-request. Need KMS/HSM integration (Cloud HSM preferred) and SOC2/ISO cert language.
- Throughput expectation for pilot: 10 concurrent agents with peak bursts to 30, average 5 req/s, 1k tokens per request.
- Latency SLO: P95 < 2s for decode-only steps (they accept longer for heavy extraction flows but want the triage summary to be under 90s).

Technical constraints and preferences:
- Deployment: Private (customer-managed control plane option). They will try Redwood on a dedicated customer subnet; prefer containerized on GKE.
- GPU footprint: have access to A2-class vms (A100-style). They asked about multi-GPU scaling and cold-start behavior.
- Model: interested in a truncated open model (Llama-family style). Concern about hallucinations and medically-sensitive false positives. They asked about retaining a model evaluation harness for safety-themed evals.
- Quantization: willing to try 4-bit for cost, but want test/eval for accuracy regression vs FP16.
- Streaming: want partial outputs for UI; need chunked streaming for summarization and progressive redaction so human reviewers can triage sooner.
- Auth: must support workload-identity / GCP SA impersonation to avoid long-lived tokens.
- Encryption: request TLS+mutual auth for control-plane <> data-plane comms. Key material must be in their HSM, no plaintext keys in Redwood control plane.

Integration gotchas (notes-to-self):
- Network egress: ensure Caldera's VPC firewall doesn't block ephemeral worker egress to private control plane endpoints. Need list of FQDNs and ports.
- Service account roles: Caldera's infra team often under-provisions IAM roles; check required minimal roles for node bootstrapping and KMS access.
- KV cache persistence: their workload has many short conversations; recommend short-lived KV caching with sticky routing to reduce cold KV misses. Document consequences of per-request affinity.
- Token accounting: they need billable metrics per request for internal chargeback. Map Redwood token metrics to their billing meter (tokens -> patient-case-minute).
- Model fallbacks: plan fallback to smaller quantized model if heavy load; confirm fallback preserves redaction correctness.

Evaluation / safety plan suggestions (proposed):
- Create a small eval harness: 500 redaction-sensitive prompts + 100 annotated edge cases from Dr. Patel. Baseline with FP16 and 4-bit. Track precision/recall for PII redaction and hallucination rate.
- Establish a canary rollout (5% traffic -> 25% -> 100%) for new model/quantization. Include automatic rollback if redaction precision drops >2% or hallucination rate increases beyond threshold.

Immediate action items (owners + rough ETA):
- Maya: Draft a one-page architecture diagram showing Private deployment on GKE + HSM flow + required public endpoints. ETA: 2024-11-10.
- Jamal: Prepare a short runbook listing firewall FQDNs/ports and minimal IAM roles for node startup and KMS access. ETA: 2024-11-12.
- Priya: Collate 100 representative clinical snippets for the eval harness and flag 20 high-risk cases. ETA: 2024-11-20.
- Liam: Confirm availability of A2-class GPUs and whether multi-GPU within pod is allowed in their infra; send cluster quotas. ETA: 2024-11-14.

Open questions to resolve with Caldera (to bring to eng product):
- Can we expose a per-request audit log (immutable) in a format they can ingest into BigQuery? Need schema.
- What SLA do they require for Dedicated vs Private? They mentioned 99.9% but need to map to node-level vs control-plane SLA.
- How important is deterministic output for triage? If very high, we should recommend seed/temperature locking and a deterministic model variant.

Notes for internal engineering sync:
- Follow-up with runtime team about mTLS support between control plane and private workers; there are outstanding PRs.
- Check tooling for streaming + mid-response redaction tagging — may need small SDK helper to emit partial redaction masks.
- Ensure Optimize team is looped on batching config; given 1k tokens/request and low concurrency, batching may not be huge win but KV caching definitely helps.

Demo plan for next call (proposed agenda):
1) Quick architecture walkthrough (Maya) - 10m
2) Demo stub on private cluster (Jamal) - 15m (show streaming summary + progressive redaction)
3) Eval harness proposal & metrics (Priya + Dr. S) - 10m
4) Next steps + action review - 5m

Scratch reminders / private jots:
- Add sample curl for workload-identity flow to examples repo.
- Add small note about truncation handling when summarizing long clinical notes (important for extracting medication lists).
- Add tokenization sanity check for common clinical terms (mg, mcg, dates) to avoid weird splits.

End of scratchpad. Will iterate after Jamal's runbook + Maya diagram come back.
